final: WITH staff_counts AS (SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental GROUP BY staff_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(rental_count) AS total_count FROM staff_counts), shares AS (SELECT sc.staff_id, sc.rental_count, CAST(sc.rental_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM staff_counts sc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_count FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.rental_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.rental_count - a.average_count) FROM shares s CROSS JOIN averages a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND s.rental_count > a.average_count
